title: Epistemic Trustworthiness in Generative AI: A Normative Framework for Warranted Reliance in High-Stakes Workflows
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society
why: Asks when reliance on a generative output is epistemically warranted rather than merely induced. That is the normative half of professional criticality in high-stakes work.
caveat: A conceptual framework from computer ethics. The professional cases are illustrative, not studied.
